liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (5 reviews): Phil's playing on Foolish Heart is singled out as especially strong; The jam coming out of Foolish Heart sounds distinctively fresh [20][22][23][24][29]
- **Queen Jane Approximately** (2 reviews): Bobby forgot lyrics several times in Queen Jane; Bob flubs and forgets a chunk of Queen Jane [28][30]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): The China Cat into Rider sequence is singled out as outstanding; Uncle John's opener leads into a driving China Cat with a standout Jerry solo [20][30]
- **Easy To Love You** (1 review): Easy To Love You is called nice, with a nod to the lost band member [23]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Uncle John's flowing into China Cat and Rider is praised as sweet Jerry playing [22]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Estimated Prophet is called awesome, followed by a cool Scarlet-like jam out of Foolish Heart [28]
- A Promised Land tease occurred at the end of the first set [2]
- A Promised Land false start came after Bird Song [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-06-08.149702.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1990-06-08.147925.sbd.ladner-braverman.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 161 min [4]. Said about its sound: Source is not pristine; level fluctuations early in Cold Rain, and a high-pitched whistle before some first-set songs [4]
- **gd90-06-08.schoeps-fob.georges.9630.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 4.36/5 by 22 [5]. Said about its sound: The audience source sounds great, recorded from the impact zone [24]
- **gd1990-06-08.fob.alabamabob.andrewf.95184.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 157 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [9]
- **gd90-06-08.sbd-matrix.ladner.6935.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 161 min; rated 4.75/5 by 24 [15]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the matrix recording's quality great; Reviewer describes the matrix recording as crisp [20][22]

## Around the show

- Reviewer finds it not a standout among 1990 shows, with better spring and summer shows [29]
- Reviewer says this may not be the best of the Dead's runs at this venue, though solid [30]
- Reviewer recommends all three nights, and says the Cal Expo and Shoreline shows of this run are all strong [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-06-08.149702.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 19, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [1]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several sets of masters combined to make the show complete [1]
- **gd1990-06-08.147925.sbd.ladner-braverman.flac16**: transferred by Chris Ladner and Peter Braverman; source: Matrix SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHN > FLAC [4]. Also: A re-cutting of Chris Ladner's seed 6935, converted to FLAC and normalized; looks soundboard-based but has significant audience component [4]
- **gd90-06-08.schoeps-fob.georges.9630.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Sean Weber; transferred by Nick Georges; source: Audience [5]
- **gd1990-06-08.fob.alabamabob.andrewf.95184.flac16**: taped by Alabama Bob; transferred by Andrew F.; source: FOB AUD: 2x Sennheiser MD421's plus 1x Nakamichi CM300 with CP1 cardioid capsule blend mic > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XL-IIS 90's with no Dolby. Set up 30 feet… [9]. Also: Patched with ShnID 9630 audio at High Time/It's All Over Now and the start of Uncle John's Band [9]
- **gd90-06-08.sbd-matrix.ladner.6935.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB Matrix SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHN. End of Sugar Magnolia and encore: Schoeps CMC 441's > PCM > SL2000 > DAT > Cass > SHN (Kutick/Adelman) [15]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead BGP Laminate, Cal Expo Amphitheatre](https://www.dead.net/archives/1990/artwork/bgp-laminate-cal-expo-amphitheatre) [37]

claims.text: The China Cat into Rider sequence is singled out as outstanding
Phil's playing on Foolish Heart is singled out as especially strong
Reviewer calls the matrix recording's quality great
Uncle John's flowing into China Cat and Rider is praised as sweet Jerry playing
The jam coming out of Foolish Heart sounds distinctively fresh
Reviewer describes the matrix recording as crisp
Easy To Love You is called nice, with a nod to the lost band member
Foolish Heart sits in an unusual spot but works as a transition into Drums; Garcia noodles with his MIDI rig at the end
Phil goes wild over the band during the Foolish Heart into Drums stretch
The audience source sounds great, recorded from the impact zone
Bobby forgot lyrics several times in Queen Jane
Estimated Prophet is called awesome, followed by a cool Scarlet-like jam out of Foolish Heart
The post-Foolish Heart jam is rated among the best pre-drums jams, with Jerry's MIDI work and adventurous Phil
Reviewer finds it not a standout among 1990 shows, with better spring and summer shows
Bob flubs and forgets a chunk of Queen Jane
Uncle John's opener leads into a driving China Cat with a standout Jerry solo
Reviewer says this may not be the best of the Dead's runs at this venue, though solid
Reviewer recommends all three nights, and says the Cal Expo and Shoreline shows of this run are all strong
Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several sets of masters combined to make the show complete
A Promised Land tease occurred at the end of the first set
A re-cutting of Chris Ladner's seed 6935, converted to FLAC and normalized; looks soundboard-based but has significant audience component
Source is not pristine; level fluctuations early in Cold Rain, and a high-pitched whistle before some first-set songs
Patched with ShnID 9630 audio at High Time/It's All Over Now and the start of Uncle John's Band
A Promised Land false start came after Bird Song
